doc: Verification status of each capability on each platform (release plan §2.5, D-201). status: real (run on real hardware or a real system service), software (run on a software implementation or a virtual device: correctness, not performance), unverified (implemented to the contract, its own tests and the CPU reference pass, but no environment to run this path here: neither a pass nor a red, not evidence), unsupported (the capability query says no). real and software name their evidence (a case, a script, a run); unverified says what is missing; a tier-1 stable cell that is unverified says what graduates it. omui-devtools platforms writes docs/{en,zh}/platforms.md from this file.

capability.name: CPU reference rendering, simulation and the semantic tree
capability.label: stable

web.needs: which WebGPU adapter tools/ci/browser.sh's headless Chromium runs on is not recorded; a real browser on a real GPU

macos-arm64.evidence: CI row macos-15: the runner's Apple Paravirtual Metal device (tools/ci/gpu.sh, cocoa)

windows-x64.evidence: CI row windows-2022: lavapipe through SDL_GPU's Vulkan backend

android.needs: a device run; CI builds and runs the emulator without a GPU device case

linux-x64.evidence: RTX 4080 headless (tools/dev/gpu-real.sh): quay.picture.device; lavapipe on CI

web.evidence: Quay's frame on headless Chromium's SwiftShader WebGPU (showcase/quay web_frame_test --frames 20: 46 draws, 8 lights; ~3 s a frame, not performance)
